values: 一名拥有强大力量的半人马战士，能够摧毁战场上的阻挡。
A fierce and resolute centaur warrior, his charges can obliterate anything that stands in his way.
None can stand in my way.
看好了，机会只有一次！别错过
Eyes sharp! One strike is all you get! Don't waste it.
是时候松松筋骨了……下令吧，我随时待命！
My muscles ache for battle. Say the word and I'll run wild!
想和我较量？来吧，尽管放马过来！
Hmph. Want to dance with death? Then step forward! I'm ready,
谢谢你的善意，我将回赠。
You honor me. I shall repay you in kind.
Do not try to tame me.
Shame I can't really run wild here...
赞东常被问起的一个无聊问题是，四条腿是不是比两条腿跑得快？这个问题的答案毋庸置疑，他也以自己的速度为傲。
"Are four legs faster than two?" Fools ask Zandrok this too often. His speed is the only answer he ever needs and the only one they ever remember.
赞东的族群都是天生的战士，拉弓和奔跑，是他们一生下来就会做的事。
Zandrok's people are born warriors. Archery and galloping through the land come as naturally to them as breathing.
当家园被外敌入侵，即将毁于一旦时，是赞东点亮了火把，勇敢带领族人反抗。他决不允许别人夺走自己的自由。
When invaders threatened to destroy their homeland, it was Zandrok who raised the torch and led his people in defiance. This warrior will never let anyone take their freedom... not without a fight.
赞东的斧子是由特殊材质的矿石、木头、骨头打造的，斧子上的每一道刻痕，都是他誓死捍卫自由的见证。
Zandrok's axe was forged from rare ore, hardened wood, and bone. Every scar on its blade a reminder of his oath to defend freedom, no matter the cost.
每次战斗结束后，赞东会独自找个没人的小溪仔细清洗自己的胡须和鬃毛，他不喜欢被人服侍，整理毛发的时间也够他品味胜利的愉悦。
After every battle, Zandrok slips away to some quiet stream to scrub his beard and mane clean alone. He never likes being fussed over, and this personal ritual gives him time to savor his victory.
没有人知道巫毒神庙从哪里找来了这么一位强大且心性坚忍的战士，他执行任务干脆利落，从不费多余的力气，于是长老们选定他去看守封印之地。

No one knew where the Temple of Seers found a warrior as fierce and unshakable as Zandrok. He handles every mission with brutal efficiency. When the elders needed a guardian for the Sealed Grounds, he was their only choice.
独自看守封印之地的日子并不无聊，因为那里常年盘桓着仿佛不属于这个世界的遥远声音，赞东的许多前任都因此而精神错乱，但赞东坚持至今。
Guarding the Sealed Grounds alone is never dull. Otherworldly whispers fill the air, driving many before Zandrok to madness. But he stands firm, a sentinel unbent by time or terror.
赞东很少提起他来到巫毒神庙之前的过去，那是因为他已经将家园倾覆的仇恨咽下，他承诺在为神庙工作期满前不复仇，却无法平息内心的烈火。

Zandrok rarely speaks of his life before the Temple of Seers. He has swallowed the hatred for those who destroyed his homeland, vowing not to seek revenge until his service ends. But the fire inside him? That never dies.
巫毒神庙中有许多人赏识赞东，想追随他左右，但赞东更喜欢独来独往。
Many in the Temple of Seers admire Zandrok and want to follow him, but the warrior prefers to walk his path alone.
失去家园后，赞东去过了许多地方，见过了很多人。但归途还没找到，他还在路上。
After losing his homeland, Zandrok wandered far and met many people. But the path home still eludes him. His journey isn't yet over.
Shame I can't really run wild here...
咕唔！汝竟与吾如此相像！
Hoot! By what trick of fate dost thou mirror mine own form?
